verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe cross-device continuation in both directions. Remote Control lets you keep working on a terminal session from your phone or any browser, and `claude --teleport` pulls a task started on the web or mobile app into your terminal. Web sessions also let you kick off long tasks and check back later. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how session state and context transfer between devices, any limits on Remote Control or teleport, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser

citations.quote: Step away from your desk and keep working from your phone or any browser with Remote Control
Kick off a long-running task on the web or the Claude mobile app, then pull it into your terminal with `claude --teleport`.
Kick off long-running tasks and check back when they're done
